title: Sony A7 III Camera Body $1519 (Sony Members Discount Code) Delivered @ Sony
body:
Deal: Sony A7 III Camera Body $1519 (Sony Members Discount Code) Delivered @ Sony

[thrillho] Still a great camera, and geez, it's held its value pretty well if this a good sale price. I pair mine with the 24-105 f/4 G lens and it's a fantastic, capable combo.
[langitbiru] good camera. very popular during it first new came out.
Some things i dont like:
- colour doesnt looks very great, a bit yellowish for certain situation
- the LCD screen output colour doesnt reflect the image taken. If you view the same image on LCD vs the viewfinder, you can see the LCD show a poor colour
But, again, i am talking this based on the unit i had. NOt sure if others have the same experience or not.
[ScoutOP] Hi mate,
Try playing around with the white balance settings to correct the yellowish tones.
As for your second concern, Sony's LCD screens aren't always the most colour-accurate, and this isn't necessarily specific to the A7 III. That's one reason many videographers and photographers use an external monitor when they need a more reliable colour reference.
Hope that helps!
